title: GTA 6: 11 minutes. Real Florida: 12 hours.
lines: GTA 6: eleven minutes. Real Florida: twelve hours.
What if you drove the real Leonida instead of the game?
Rockstar says Leonida is about twice the size of GTA 5's map.
In Kotaku's test, crossing it on the highway took about eleven minutes.
But Leonida is based on Florida: Vice City is Miami, Grassrivers is the Everglades, and the Keys are the Keys.
The real drive, from Key West to Pensacola, is about eight hundred and thirty miles.
That's over twelve hours behind the wheel, with no stops.
Real Florida also covers about sixty-six thousand square miles, with thirteen hundred and fifty miles of coast.
